Name: Byeol's Seasonal Stone House Edit
Author: scriibyeol
Description:
Content patcher mod that edits the stone cabin to be the default farmhouse! Does not replace the original assets in the base game

This is my first ever attempt at a mod and I though I have tested it, I haven’t done a playthrough of the game with it installed since I've been in school. If you notice anything wonky or not working properly, please let me know! Even if it’s as small as a stray pixel, it is much appreciated :D

Features[list]
[*]Seasonal textures 
[*]Toggles for Grapeponta’s Pastoral Recolor and DaisyNiko’s Earthy recolour
[*]Optional vines (available with both recolors, also changes with the seasons)
[*]Seasonal decorations (can also be turned off)
[/list]
NOTE: For this mod to work with pastoral recolor, you will need to turn off “Buildings: Farm” in the menu!

Installation[list]
[*]Download latest versions of Smapi, Content Patcher, and Generic Mod Config Menu
[*]Download, unzip, and drop into your Mods folder
[*]That’s all! 
[/list][left]
Inspiration credit to Elle’s Seasonal Buildings, they inspired a lot of the decor in this mod! All assets are either from the vanilla game or drawn myself! If anyone tries out this mod, I hope that you enjoy!! :﻿DD[/left]
